title: 2.8.2.9-dev: Profiles in NS deleted when going through setup wizard
symptom: Clean install of AAPS to a new phone without importing settings, using the wizard and connecting to NS results in deletion of all existing profiles in NS.
cause: AAPS by default is set to upload data and to receive/sync profiles, which causes deletion of existing profiles when a new profile is created and sent to NS.
fix: Disable accepting profiles from NS if you don't use NS for editing profiles, so local profile always stays intact. Alternatively, use NS profile editor to clone old profiles to make them newer and sent to AAPS.
evidence_quote: if you don't use NS for editing profiles you can disable accepting profiles from NS. then local profile always stay intact
